# `/role-mining-potential-roles` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /role-mining-potential-roles/v1

`getAllPotentialRoleSummariesV1` — Retrieves all potential role summaries — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage, iai:access-modeling:read

- Returns 200: array of roleminingpotentialrolesummary

### GET /role-mining-potential-roles/v1/{potentialRoleId}

`getRoleMiningPotentialRoleV1` — Retrieves a specific potential role — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This method returns a specific potential role.

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage, iai:access-modeling:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `potentialRoleId` (path, required) — A potential role id
- Returns 200: roleminingpotentialrole

### PATCH /role-mining-potential-roles/v1/{potentialRoleId}

`patchPotentialRoleV1` — Update a potential role — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

The method updates an existing potential role using. The following fields can be modified: * `description` * `name` * `saved` >**NOTE: All other fields cannot be modified.**

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `sessionId` (path, required) — The role mining session id
  - `potentialRoleId` (path, required) — The potential role summary id
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperationrolemining
- Returns 200: object
